key: Canopy node collision sphere radius, as a FRACTION OF CANOPY DIAMETER. english: Canopy node collision sphere radius, as a FRACTION OF CANOPY DIAMETER. id: display:How big the triangles are: min(R, h)^2 / 2 of the coarsest triangle a dent lands on. The slope bound keeps the smooth field injective, but the mesh is flat triangles; this and 'min gap' bound how far a triangle's chord may stray from it. Either at 0 turns the guard off.
key: How big the triangles are: min(R, h)^2 / 2 of the coarsest triangle a dent lands on. The slope bound keeps the smooth field injective, but the mesh is flat triangles; this and 'min gap' bound how far a triangle's chord may stray from it. Either at 0 turns the guard off.
english: How big the triangles are: min(R, h)^2 / 2 of the coarsest triangle a dent lands on. The slope bound keeps the smooth field injective, but the mesh is flat triangles; this and 'min gap' bound how far a triangle's chord may stray from it. Either at 0 turns the guard off.
chinese: 描述三角形的粗细：取凹痕覆盖的最粗三角形的 min(R, h)^2 / 2。斜率上界保证平滑变形场为单射，但网格由平面三角形组成；此参数与“最小间隙”共同限制三角形弦线偏离平滑场的程度。任一值为 0 时关闭此保护。

id: history:Add long distance shadow cascades to the plume trails. This is implemented using moment shadowmaps which can encode the volumetric shape of the shadows in a compact representation, the shadows themselves are rendered using an analytic approximation rather than full raymarching for performance. Cascade updates are staggered for performance, and a blend is used to hide updates, the nearest cascade is always rendered every frame. Performance is good currently but some minor issues remain when the plume is diffusing to disappear. This feature can be disabled from the graphics settings.

chinese: 为尾焰轨迹添加远距离级联阴影，使用矩阴影贴图紧凑地编码体积阴影形状。为保证性能，阴影采用解析近似而非完整光线步进。各级联错开更新，并通过混合隐藏更新跳变；最近的级联每帧渲染。目前性能良好，但尾焰扩散消失时仍有少量问题。可在图形设置中关闭此功能。

id: history:Added a hardcoded sprite scale cap to the star binary loader. Any star asking for a scale byte above 128 is clamped on load, and a warning per binary says how many were. The cap sits just above Sirius in the Hipparcos import (121), so hip_main.bin is unaffected and only overcooked imports lose their largest sprites. This is added because the shader isn't constructed to handle sprites that are this large.

id: history:Added sky star masking. After a system loads, every catalogue star inside a sphere around each of its stellar bodies is dropped from the star instance buffer, so no sprite draws beside a real StellarBody as parallax moves it. The loaded binaries are kept in a master array and the drawn set is rebuilt from it on each system load, so switching systems restores masked stars.

id: history:Added specular anti-aliasing. Unlike most anti-aliasing techniques specular AA is applied inside of the fragment shader to try to reduce aliasing before it happens. The core of the effect is reducing specularity around the edge of meshes to combat against mipped textures decreasing the roughness at certain viewing angles.

id: history:Added stars_20byte.bin, a community-made star binary built by Briar Thrain from in our community who provided us an excellent binary before. They have provided a lot of advice and help about how to approach these binaries, as well as making many excellent mods. I believe they used the AT-HYG catalogue (Tycho-2, Gaia DR3 and HYG) which provides an excellent result. It carries Gaia-quality distances for parallax and picks up neighbours Hipparcos lacked, such as Groombridge 34. Together with this I switched the Core mod to it in place of hip_main.bin.

id: history:Changed the mask radius to default to 2% of the star's distance from Sol rather than its orbital extent. Catalogue parallax error is roughly a fifth of a percent of distance and dwarfs any planetary system, so an orbital-extent sphere misses the catalogue entry (Alpha Centauri's sits 1.2% off). key: Changed the release build to compile with full compiler optimisations. Every build shipped until now ran without them, so the game was doing more CPU work than it needed to everywhere. Expect higher and steadier frame rates, fewer stutters in busy scenes, and shorter loading times. The gain is largest where the CPU was the limit, such as big vessels, dense maps and timewarp, and smallest where the GPU already was.
english: Changed the release build to compile with full compiler optimisations. Every build shipped until now ran without them, so the game was doing more CPU work than it needed to everywhere. Expect higher and steadier frame rates, fewer stutters in busy scenes, and shorter loading times. The gain is largest where the CPU was the limit, such as big vessels, dense maps and timewarp, and smallest where the GPU already was.
chinese: 正式构建现在启用完整编译器优化。此前发布的所有构建均未启用，导致 CPU 在各处执行了不必要的工作。预期帧率更高且更稳定、繁忙场景卡顿更少、加载更快；大型飞船、密集地图和时间加速等受 CPU 限制的场景收益最大，原本受 GPU 限制的场景收益最小。

key: Fixed "Applying surface motion to a single vehicle in a non-CCF frame" errors flooding the screen with debris on the surface. A physics bubble that split off another or was created for a vehicle on load, kept the frame it started with and a lone landed or floating vehicle was never moved to the planet-fixed frame, so it logged errors every step indefinitely. The bubble now switches to the planet-fixed frame before moving a vehicle along the surface.
english: Fixed "Applying surface motion to a single vehicle in a non-CCF frame" errors flooding the screen with debris on the surface. A physics bubble that split off another or was created for a vehicle on load, kept the frame it started with and a lone landed or floating vehicle was never moved to the planet-fixed frame, so it logged errors every step indefinitely. The bubble now switches to the planet-fixed frame before moving a vehicle along the surface.
chinese: 修复地面残骸导致“在非 CCF 参考系中对单艘飞船施加地表运动”错误刷屏的问题。分裂产生或加载飞船时创建的物理气泡保留了初始参考系，单独着陆或漂浮的飞船始终没有切到天体固连参考系，因而每步都报错。现在沿地表移动飞船前，气泡会先切换到天体固连参考系。

id: history:Recooked the binary's header magnitude scale from 1.0 to 0.15. The header value drives the parallax brightness exponent and has to match how the sprite sizes fall off with magnitude, which a fit over 29 named stars put at 0.15. At 1.0 a star approached to half its Sol distance drew 32 times larger; it now draws about 1.7 times larger, in line with the Hipparcos import.

english: Recooked the binary's header magnitude scale from 1.0 to 0.15. id: utility:Welcome to the KSA pre-alpha.<Separator/>The game currently has you controlling a craft named 'Rocket'. Press <Action:VesselNext />, <Action:VesselPrevious/> to swap between several available craft.<NewLine/>You can press <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> to switch between the camera modes, or hold right click to pan the camera around. Most UI elements can be repositioned, resized and hidden, by clicking and dragging.<NewLine/>KSA uses fairly traditional craft controls, which can be viewed in the 'Controls' section of the settings menus by pressing <Action:OpenGameSettings/>.<NewLine/>Press <Action:ToggleMap/> to toggle between craft view, and map view. The map view can be useful for planning burns for encounters and exploring the solar system, but controls slightly change while in this mode. You can also use this to prepare burns by left clicking on a point in the orbit.<NewLine/>In the menu bar, you can use 'Universe' -> 'Goto' and you can instantly move to other celestial objects as well as using 'View' -> 'Orbit Lines' to enable or disable orbit lines for the many available celestials. Many other in progress features can be accessed by exploring the menu bar.<NewLine/>Time compression can be increased using <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> and decreased with <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/>. Ground Tracking can be toggled with <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> and transfer planning with <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/>.<Separator/>

chinese: 欢迎体验 KSA 预 Alpha 版。<Separator/>初始场景中，你操控的是名为“Rocket”的飞船。按 <Action:VesselNext /> 或 <Action:VesselPrevious/> 可在几艘现有飞船之间切换。<NewLine/>按 <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> 可切换相机模式；按住鼠标右键可转动视角。大多数界面面板可以通过点击、拖动来移动、调整大小或隐藏。<NewLine/>KSA 使用常见的飞船操控方式。按 <Action:OpenGameSettings/> 打开设置，在“控制”页查看键位。<NewLine/>按 <Action:ToggleMap/> 可切换飞船视图与地图视图。地图适合规划交会机动和探索太阳系，但操控方式会略有变化。在轨道上的某一点单击鼠标左键，也可在该处规划机动。<NewLine/>在菜单栏中，选择“宇宙”→“天体”菜单中的目标，可立即转到其他天体；选择“视图”→“轨道线”，可开关各天体的轨道线。菜单栏中还可以找到其他正在开发的功能。<NewLine/>按 <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> 提高时间加速倍率，按 <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/> 降低倍率。按 <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> 打开或关闭地面轨迹，按 <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/> 打开或关闭转移规划。<Separator/>
context: 欢迎弹窗的入门说明；必须保留所有 Action/Separator/NewLine 标记及顺序，Action卡片复用原按键绑定。原文旧称 Goto，此构建实际菜单名 Move Camera To（将相机移至）；中文按现有菜单名说明。仅此弹窗按中文字符拆分换行，不修改全局富文本解析器。
